description: Create beautiful photo collages instantly with dynamic layouts and adjustable gaps.

howToUse:
1. Upload multiple images to the workspace.
2. Choose your preferred layout format (Row, Column, Grid).
3. Adjust the Gap and Corner Radius sliders to fine-tune the look.
4. Select a background color.
5. Click 'DOWNLOAD' to save your high-resolution collage.
features:
• Canvas Rendering
• Dynamic Grid Options
• High-Resolution Export
